migration: authority-transition-protocol: Existing lifecycle and evidence documents keep their released meaning. New authority transitions use the transition-only schema majors and the project-owned protected-transition policy; ordinary changes and historical readers remain unchanged.; bounded-review-correction-loops: Historical change, review, lifecycle, completion and receipt documents retain their released meaning. After adoption, decision windows start prospectively; a third changes-requested review requires owner resolution before another implementation cycle. New finite-boundary changes use change schema 4 and bind every finding as covered or contract-gap. Contract gaps remain open and require a superseding change rather than in-place contract mutation.

provenance.statement: Public 0.7.0 and the reviewed source-owned transition verifier authorize this one-time transition release.

changes.rationale: Separate governing lifecycle authority from candidate materialization, add a source-owned protected transition verifier, and make trust-root cutovers explicit and fail closed.

Stop autonomous review correction after three changes-requested cycles, require the existing reviewed owner-decision chain before resuming, and give new high-risk changes a finite fault-row review boundary.
Keep the authored Release-plan handoff within GitHub's repository-dispatch property limit while preserving exact planned run and attempt identity in a protected-base-controlled adapter.
